title: The Saturday Selection, Vol. 128
summary: Salon shutters, Norm MacDonald, ‘Overdrive’ errors, and much more.
content:
Every day, WITI’s group chats buzz with fresh links. As part of our Saturday send for paid readers, we round up 11 of the best.

It’s WITI, on the weekend.

Why are these interesting?

Norm MacDonald on Sobriety, Alcohol, and Life Without Drinking (YouTube)

Filmed seemingly on the fly in a Poker Hall.

Goodbye from Salon (Salon)

“Today, after 31 years, we are saddened to announce that Salon is ceasing publication.”

The Onion is Trying to Sponsor a College Football Bowl Game (Yahoo)

“The Onion initially pitched the game as The Sickos Bowl, paying homage to the online community of college football fans that will watch any game no matter the quality of the teams participating.”

Father John Misty - The Suburbs, Arcade Fire Cover (YouTube)

Over five million views and counting.
